title: Bepirovirsen: first antisense drug for hepatitis B

research.what: Ionis's antisense oligonucleotide bepirovirsen, partnered with GSK, showed functional-cure responses in chronic hepatitis B in a Phase 2b study. Origin: Ionis antisense hepatitis B programme (bepirovirsen); earliest sourced milestone is Phase 2b data, Nov 2022. The preclinical origin is earlier but not sourced here.

change.what: The FDA approved Hibsago (bepirovirsen) on 20 Oct 2026, the first antisense oligonucleotide for chronic hepatitis B, alongside an FDA-authorised HBsAg companion test.

note: It is the first approved therapy built around a functional-cure endpoint for hepatitis B, with 19% functional cure in pooled Phase 3 trials. The research-origin year is understated, so the lag is uncertain.
